Tokushima University's International Student Center (ISC) publishes step-by-step admission guidance for international students across its graduate programmes, including document requirements, screening timelines and scholarship options such as tuition reductions and MEXT routes. Each intake's windows are listed on the admission-steps page.

Programme Highlights

  • Structured admission guidance for Japanese graduate programmes
  • Scholarship and tuition-reduction information consolidated by the ISC
  • Regional Japanese university with lower living costs than Tokyo
  • Engineering, bioscience and science graduate schools

Who Should Apply

International applicants to Tokushima's master's and doctoral programmes, following the steps for their chosen graduate school.

Funding and Costs

Tuition reductions and MEXT/university scholarship routes are described in the admission guidance. Confirm the exact funding package on the official page before applying.

Deadline and How to Apply

Open the ISC admission-steps page, choose your graduate school and intake, and follow the listed document and timing requirements. Key deadline information: Application windows per the ISC admission-steps page for each intake.

Official Source

  • Official application page (verified link)

About Tokushima University

Tokushima University is a Japanese national university with graduate schools in engineering, bioscience and health, supporting international applicants through its International Student Center.

Official website: https://www.tokushima-u.ac.jp

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: Varies by programme - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
